claim: arch_plan_command.md's Exit Codes section still lists a malformed/unreadable journal under exit 1 ("`1` — input validation error (bad flags, malformed JSON, diff carries errors, unreadable `--beads` or journal). Stderr names the flag or the input that failed."), which contradicts the same leaf's own Pre-flight step 3 a few lines above ("the lifecycle pre-flight refuses an uninitialised or broken project before the fold is reached" — a broken project, including an unparseable journal per arch_project_resolver.md/test_resolver.md, exits with the not-a-spex-project code, not 1). test_plan_command.md's S12 mirrors the same stale claim verbatim ("Unreadable or malformed inputs (missing diff file, malformed JSON, unreadable `--beads` or journal) → 1"). drifts/drift-spexmachina-uiei.7.json already reported the neighboring gap — the Exit Codes section lacked any bullet at all for the not-a-spex-project code — but its proposed_fix only adds a fourth bullet 'alongside its existing three-way list'; it does not touch the second bullet's own 'or journal' clause, which still claims exit 1 for exactly the malformed-journal input the new fourth bullet and the pre-flight section both now route to a different code.
authoritative_source: arch_plan_command.md's own Pre-flight section (step 3, line 36) and spec/lifecycle/arch_project_resolver.md/test_resolver.md, which are unambiguous that an unparseable journal is broken project state (not-a-spex-project exit code, naming `spex doctor`) — not an ordinary input-validation failure. cmd/spex/plan_test.go's TestPlanCommand_S12_MalformedJournalLine_BrokenProject (added by this PR) asserts exactly that: exit code exitNotAProject (3), stderr naming `spex doctor`, for a malformed journal line.
evidence: This PR's PlanCommand pre-flight calls lifecycle.Resolve before the fold is reached (matching arch_plan_command.md line 36), so a malformed journal at .spex/history.jsonl is caught there and returns a *lifecycle.BrokenError (exit 3) before PlanCommand's own journal-fold code — the one that would exit 1 for a read/parse failure it detects itself — ever runs. The malformed-journal case can therefore no longer reach exit 1 through `spex plan`, yet both arch_plan_command.md's Exit Codes bullet 2 and test_plan_command.md's S12 bullet 2 still list it there. Applying drift-spexmachina-uiei.7.json's proposed_fix verbatim (only adding a fourth bullet) would leave this second, narrower contradiction in place — two bullets of the same section would then name two different exit codes for the same input.
proposed_fix: When drift-spexmachina-uiei.7.json is triaged, also drop 'or journal' from arch_plan_command.md's Exit Codes bullet 2 (exit 1 stays for bad flags, malformed diff JSON, and unreadable `--beads`; the journal case is fully covered by the new not-a-spex-project bullet, since PlanCommand never reaches its own journal-read code without the pre-flight having already resolved a readable one) and from test_plan_command.md's S12 second bullet's parenthetical the same way, alongside adding the fourth case both leaves are already missing.
